# predictant_mask { #wass2s.predictant_mask }

```python
predictant_mask(data)
```

Create a mask for predictand data based on rainfall thresholds and latitude.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type             | Description                                                                 | Default    |
|--------|------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| data   | xarray.DataArray | Input data array with a time dimension 'T' and spatial dimensions 'Y', 'X'. | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type             | Description                                          |
|--------|------------------|------------------------------------------------------|
|        | xarray.DataArray | Mask with 1 where conditions are met, NaN elsewhere. |

## Notes {.doc-section .doc-section-notes}

The mask is set to 1 where mean rainfall > 20 mm and latitude is within ±19.5 degrees,
otherwise NaN.
